"For Android Live Updates:
1. Open Settings > About phone/tablet > Software information.
2. Tap Build number seven times and confirm your screen lock.
3. Return to Settings > Developer options.
4. Turn on Live notifications for all apps.
5. Make sure Settings > Lock screen and AOD > Now bar is enabled.

If “Live notifications for all apps” is missing, select Samsung compatibility above. Samsung changes third-party access by model, region, and firmware build even when Android and One UI versions match.

If both modes remain ordinary notifications, that firmware or device does not expose a third-party Now Bar surface. Codex Meter cannot override Samsung’s system allowlist."

"Newer and matching releases from Codex Meter %1$s onward are checksum- and signature-verified in the app. Releases before %2$s are irreversible and must be installed from GitHub because those builds lack working in-app updates. Other older versions still require uninstalling first, which removes local data and widgets. Alpha builds are the exception: they share the stable version code, so the newest stable release always installs back in place."

Register the PC widget pairing code once. Both devices must use the same ChatGPT account and local network, with the PC widget running. Wi-Fi reconnect, app launch or a successful refresh merges the last 90 days of observations and shares mobile daily archives and tier with the PC. Background retries are best effort and may be delayed by battery policy. Allow only private networks in Windows Firewall. For remote work status, register a Tailscale pairing code and enable the status trial. Existing Wi-Fi history-sharing schedules remain unchanged.
